title: Hello (mini-system)
description: Relocatable job: MESSAGE to the dayfile, WRITEC to the line printer, CDD, ENDRUN.

title: Card copy (mini-system)
description: READC on INPUT (405 card reader), WRITEC on OUTPUT (line printer); the deck is supplied.
cards:
FIRST CARD
SECOND CARD WITH DIGITS 0123456789
  THIRD (+-*/=,.$)
7/8/9

title: Sum and factorial
description: Loop on a B register, 60-bit integer arithmetic, storing the results.

title: Floating-point arithmetic
description: Square root of 2 by Newton method and the 1/k² series: FX, RX, NX, PX instructions.

title: Display code text
description: DIS, LX rotations and MX masks to count the letters of a message.

title: Insertion sort
description: CON table, B indexing, comparisons by integer subtraction.

title: Macros, micros, IF, DUP, ECHO
description: Macro assembler demonstration: MACRO/LOCAL, MICRO, IFGE/ELSE, DUP, ECHO.

title: 6612 console and keyboard
description: Refresh loop for both screens (FNC/ACN/OAM/DCN) and keyboard input (IAN).

title: 1612 line printer
description: Display → external BCD conversion by table, RJM subroutines, line-by-line printing.

title: 405 card reader
description: IAM input of Hollerith cards, conversion to display code, display on the console.

title: Real-time clock
description: Clock channel 14B, 24-bit accumulation, octal display; uses XTEXT DEFS6612.

title: DEFS6612 text
description: 6612 console definitions and the SHOW macro, called by XTEXT.
